products.name: Fried Plantains (Tostones)
products.restate: These are TOSTONES: flat round smashed plantain discs, about 6cm across and 1.5cm thick, with rough cracked edges and a pale golden-tan interior. They are NOT potato fries and NOT batons. The plate must show flat round discs.

products.name: Onion Rings
products.restate: These are ONION RINGS: thick golden-battered O-shaped rings, hollow in the centre, stacked in a pile. They are NOT fries and NOT solid sticks. Every piece must be a visible ring with a hole.

products.name: Lettuce & Tomato Salad
products.restate: This is a fresh SALAD: crisp green lettuce leaves with thick slices of red tomato. Nothing is fried. There are NO potatoes, NO fries and NO ketchup ramekin anywhere on the plate.

products.name: Tossed Salad
products.restate: This is a fresh TOSSED SALAD: mixed green leaves with cucumber, tomato and red onion. Nothing is fried. There are NO potatoes, NO fries and NO ketchup ramekin anywhere on the plate.
